brief: Example: premium television campaign using an approved packshot. Scores are illustrations, not research.

concepts.name: Architectural Quiet
concepts.rationale: Frontal original television on warm travertine console; natural window light and generous type space.

evidence.brand_audience_fit: Quiet premium architecture supports refined technology positioning; confirm against client brief.
evidence.originality_visual_idea: Architectural aperture lends a specific concept, not just a generic podium.
evidence.hierarchy_negative_space: One hero product and one intentional copy region.
evidence.feasibility_product_fidelity: Original frontal packshot works without perspective distortion.
evidence.truth_copy_legibility: Only exact client-approved wording and prices are permitted.
evidence.format_crop_safe_zones: Copy and product identifiers fit within the designated 3:4 safe region.

concepts.name: Hyper-Futurist Levitation
concepts.rationale: Mirrored slabs and a floating product.

evidence.brand_audience_fit: Loud spectacle may clash with understated branding.
evidence.feasibility_product_fidelity: Product can be composited but contact and reflective realism require careful work.
evidence.format_crop_safe_zones: Slabs may collide with grid crop.

concepts.name: Precise Product Gallery
concepts.rationale: Minimal product gallery with one spotlight and optical balance.

evidence.originality_visual_idea: A known convention, not highly distinctive.
evidence.hierarchy_negative_space: One focal point and clean space.
evidence.feasibility_product_fidelity: Compatible original packshot and minimal scene.
evidence.truth_copy_legibility: Clear location for exact approved text.
evidence.format_crop_safe_zones: Planned central placement protects critical content.
